meta.title: Michelin Guide — Las Vegas, 2026 Southwest selection
meta.important_note: Las Vegas had NO Michelin Guide between 2010 and 2025. The 2026 Southwest selection (announced 31 Aug 2026 on michelin.com; the ceremony was held at Fontainebleau Las Vegas) is the first Las Vegas guide since 2009. Many older 'Michelin' claims online are stale.
meta.price_rule: price_2adults is ONLY filled where an official or reservation-platform page states the price. Blank = not verified. '++' means plus tax and gratuity, as printed by the venue.
meta.social_rule: Instagram/TikTok links are published only where the venue's own official page links to the account, or the account itself was opened on 2026-11-27 and its bio/posts tie it to this venue. The per-row evidence is in data/socials.json and in the "Where each social link came from" table on this page. Blank = no account could be tied to the venue (F-19, F-53 to F-57).

announcement_date.note: Corrected 2026-11-26; earlier copies of this dataset said 26 Aug 2026 (F-51).

meta.price_note: Restaurant prices were re-read from the venues' own menu pages on 2026-11-27. A fixed per-person price is doubled for two and labelled 'exact'; where only per-dish prices are published the cell is labelled 'est.' and the arithmetic is in price_note. Blank/'on request' means the official page printed no price. All figures are food only, before tax, gratuity and wine.

restaurants.name: Joël Robuchon
restaurants.address: 3799 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109
restaurants.exceptions: Closed Sunday and Monday. No children under 6 in the reservation. Business formal dress code.
restaurants.price_note: Menu prices are not published on the official page. Reserve and confirm.
restaurants.notes: Two independent creator videos in this dataset claim three Michelin stars — that is the pre-2010 status. The 2026 Guide lists Joël Robuchon at TWO stars, which the restaurant's own page also states. NOTE: the same page carries a dated banner ("open 4:00–8:00 PM Thu 19 – Sat 21 November") that applies to a 2026 date, not to 2027 — do not carry it forward. Also the 2026 MICHELIN Service Award went to GM Sean Christopher, so award rows and staff awards must not be confused. Reservations number 702.891.7925 printed on the official MGM Grand page (verified 2026-11-26). Instagram verified 2026-11-27: https://www.instagram.com/joelrobuchon.lasvegas/
restaurants.social_evidence: Account opened: bio links mgmgrand.com/en/restaurants/joel-robuchon-french-restaurant.html (this site's official link).
restaurants.social_caveat: Dormant: newest post 2020-08-07, and the bio still says 'Michelin 3-Star' — the pre-2010 status. The 2026 Guide gives TWO stars (F-54). Do not quote an account bio as a current award.

restaurants.name: Michael Mina
restaurants.address: 3600 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109
restaurants.exceptions: The Bellagio page's Hours of operation block reads "Monday to Sunday: Closed" and the restaurant is labelled Temporarily closed. Published seasonal closures on the same page: 22–30 Nov; 6–8, 13–15 and 20–22 Dec 2026.
restaurants.price_note: 10-course tasting menu at $295++ per person, from the official page. Two adults = $590 before tax and gratuity.
restaurants.notes: SERIOUS: the restaurant's own page shows "Temporarily closed" for all seven days, so the $590++ tasting-menu figure on this row is a price for a service that is not currently running. This row must not be presented as a bookable option without a re-check. Reopen date is not published. Do not assume it reopens before Feb 2027. Re-checked 2026-11-26: Bellagio's own dining index (bellagio.mgmresorts.com/en/restaurants.html?filter=property,Bellagio_Las_Vegas) lists Michael Mina as 'Temporarily Closed' with a $$$$ seafood label. No reopen date is published (F-23, F-43). Instagram verified 2026-11-27: https://www.instagram.com/michaelminalv/
restaurants.social_evidence: Account opened: bio 'Contemporary Coastal Cuisine Located in the Heart of the Bellagio'.
restaurants.social_caveat: Posts run to 2026-10, but Bellagio still lists the room as temporarily closed (F-23): an active feed is not proof it is open.
restaurants.price_basis: published exact, but venue temporarily closed
